<h1>Mod-Wheel Toggle</h1>

## Purpose

Enable or disable the shared **mod-wheel (CC1) broadcast** per sequencer.
One LC knob (LC8 knob 2) drives a single mod-wheel value; this view picks
which sequencers receive it.

## Interaction

Row 8 of both LPs exposes one cell per sequencer: LHS cols 1–7 = sequencers 1–7,
RHS cols 1–7 = sequencers 9–15 (sequencers 8 and 16 have no mod-wheel routing and
stay dark). Off = slate grey, on = medium blue. Either player can edit
any sequencer; both LPs update immediately.

## Shortcuts

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press row 8 cell | LP grid | Toggle that sequencer's mod-wheel routing on/off (applies on the next CC1 frame) | none |
| Turn LC8 knob 2 | LC knob | Broadcast the mod-wheel value to every sequencer whose toggle is on | any |
